description: Strongest when the opponent has just dropped a stone low into the centre column (column 3) and column 3 holds only their stones: the first stone in an empty centre column after 9+ moves, or a second on their own first after 13+ moves. Grows with move count and stones in columns 2 and 4. Not if my stone is in column 3 or the drop lands row 2+. Most weak firing is diffuse and uncovered.
effect: Small and inconsistent: changes of at most about 7 points, mostly on column 3 (zeroing it at the top dev example raised column 3 by 7 and lowered column 2 by 7; forcing it high elsewhere raised column 3 by 4); two other positions moved less than 2 points.
notes: 7 score calls. Best dev F1 0.257 (P 0.62, R 0.16), AUROC 0.58, simulation share 0.44. Top bands are clean: opponent's late first stone in column 3 (act: 0,2,6,5,0,5,0,0,2,2,1,4 goes from -0.21 to 3.84 with +3, but -0.4 with +1/5/6). Row-1 drop fires if the stone below is theirs, not mine; row-2 drops are negative. Bands 5-6 (2/3 of firing) are diffuse (last col 3 only ~1/3, col 3 low), so recall stays low. Static 'their lone stone low in col 3' rule: F1 0.17. Opening other empty columns late: weak, mostly FPs. Synthesis reaches 5.82 vs dev max 3.84.
